communityReference.note: Community levels, not an official list. These are deliberately taught reading prerequisites; higher reference levels do not reduce the additional N2 quota.

semanticBoundaries: 解く trains solving questions/puzzles, not untying knots or cancelling contracts.
収納 trains storing physical items and storage space, not receipt of funds.
書庫 trains a physical book store-room, not a compressed computer archive.
栞／しおり links only the physical bookmark sense; booklet/guidebook and the unrelated haiku term are excluded.
はさみ trains scissors, not animal claws or a hole punch.
別人 uses べつじん; the dictionary marks べつにん as obsolete kana usage, so it is not accepted here.
危うい has ordinary adjective examples; the related adverb 危うく (entry1218370, senses24756/24757) is explained together with the separate near-miss grammar function, not counted as another root.

版 trains standalone edition はん. Source sense57401 explicitly says ban when a suffix and has noun-used-as-suffix POS. Only the bound 国内版 occurrence gn3b017a is marked as a suffix, not a lexical unknown; the conditional pronunciation is taught in the usage note. ばん is not an unrestricted reading answer for standalone 版.
